conditions: The target issue is WEB-14 (exact issue identifier).
The record must be an attachment on that issue (not a comment, not a sub-issue link, not a description text mention).
The attachment's title/name must be exactly 'Deploy runbook'.
The attachment's URL must be exactly https://runbooks.northwind.example/deploy-staging (not merely a similar or nearby URL).
Both the title condition and the URL condition must hold on the same single attachment record (not one attachment matching the title and a different one matching the URL).
